description: Header file defining NEON-based mathematical utility functions for signal processing, including absolute value, sign copying, clipping, quantization, interval computation, look-up table access, piecewise function application, and safe division, within the ocudu::neon namespace.

methods.name: abs_f32
methods.description: Computes the absolute value of a NEON register containing four single-precision floats.

methods.name: copysign_f32
methods.description: Copies the sign from one NEON register to the magnitude of another.

methods.name: clip_f32
methods.description: Clips values in a NEON register to specified upper and lower bounds.

methods.name: clip_s32
methods.description: Clips 32-bit signed integers in a NEON register to specified bounds.

methods.name: check_bounds_s32
methods.description: Bounds 32-bit integers in a NEON register, setting out-of-bounds values to zero.

methods.name: quantize_f32
methods.description: Quantizes four NEON registers of log-likelihood ratios into 8-bit representation.

methods.name: compute_interval_idx
methods.description: Calculates interval indices from float values in a NEON register.

methods.name: look_up_table
methods.description: Retrieves values from a lookup table based on indices in a NEON register.

methods.name: interval_function
methods.description: Applies a piecewise function to NEON register values using lookup tables.

methods.name: safe_div
methods.description: Performs division with zero-check, returning zero if divisor is zero.
